schema_description: Hugging Face Hub model repository file: the chat template (thinking_mode enabled / disabled / adaptive, reasoning wrapped in <mm:think> .. </mm:think>).
notes: A reasoning model whose model_type (minimax_m3_vl) names no vLLM parser; vLLM serves its architecture with the minimax_m3 reasoning parser. With thinking_mode disabled the template ends the prompt with </mm:think>. The planner reads this template to name the parser and the request's thinking_mode.
